head: a1897006c445d5622d21ca5e15a2bf3c5dc54521
production_delta: Only move server.close after existing own control_thread.kill/join. Exact control.sock unlink remains next; no rescue, cleanup broadening, Engine edit, schema, timeout, process/group signal or permission change.
fixture_changes: Mark explicit shutdown attempts before public stop; never automatically repeat a failed explicit stop.
Capture first StandardError or Minitest::Assertion object/backtrace and re-raise unchanged; automatic existing public cleanup reports a secondary error without replacing the primary.

Before fixture disappearance, copy native runner/controller logs to a separate 0700 test-owned /tmp evidence directory with 0600 copies/hash/byte facts and private failure.json; bounded inventory (32 names/types), phase, complete/gone and claim-count facts plus listener marker when present.

Public excerpts bounded to768 bytes, first three traceback frames and last two failure lines per native log; redact token/password/secret/credential assignments. No config/state/credential dump or export change.
Setsid-refusal native capture stored in owned fixture log files before assertions; no deleted fixture log is called retained evidence.
deterministic_barrier: Fixture-only wrapper delegates to actual UNIXServer. After stop response, its second accept signals a Queue; fake machine stop waits for that entry. A close while that control thread is alive closes the real listener and joins the thread before returning, forcing old close-before-kill ordering to expose its accept error. Correct kill/join-first ordering reaches close with the control thread dead. No production injection or sleep-dependent race.
preserved_tests: All four original runner session/setSID/PID/executable/argv/child/no-guard-FD assertions and pinned PreparedMachineTest bytes preserved; common shutdown additionally requires namespace absent.
test_requirements: Real public stop complete/gone; finalized/cleaned; stopped; claims released; namespace/control.sock absent
First Minitest assertion identity/backtrace plus secondary cleanup error evidence/redaction
Primary failure retained after successful public cleanup
Explicit nonempty-namespace refusal preserves unrelated entry contents/inode, complete/gone and released claims, unchanged non-stopped phase, one stop attempt
native_limits: Four prior K source lanes report runtime63/663 pass and machine/session8/104 with three cleanup_socket errors. Native inventory/runner stderr were missing; this source interleaving is not a proven native or historical campaign cause.
retention_limit: Private copies outlive the temporary fixture inside the hosted runner. Existing workflow does not export those private files; do not claim downloadable host artifacts. Bounded redacted excerpts and hashes are emitted to native suite output.
protected_scope: Only two owned files and the separately root-owned doc differ from HEAD. No untracked paths; all other tracked source/inputs/schema/captures/PNGs and other repositories/private campaigns unchanged.
compatibility: State2/connection1/process/control/cleanup contracts unchanged. This is future shutdown ordering, not retained-root recovery or authorization to touch G4/G6.
next_gate: Root inspection and normal source consolidation/publication, exact K/E hosted proof and affected committed review before package/real work.
